name: fd-fused-ratification-toll-integrity
source_domain: Fusion of human-in-the-loop ratification ergonomics with guild assay/hallmark metrology: the price of a confirmation and the property a mark certifies, treated as one quantity. Hallmarking separates maker, assay office and buyer so the toll is paid to an independent warden who does not care what the test cost; this estate collapses maker and office into one person, so nothing but the price mk chose to pay separates a real mark from a hollow one.
distance_rationale: The two parents are near-orthogonal and each is blind exactly where the other sees. fd-hci-ratification-cost prices the human act and is explicitly indifferent to whether the resulting certificate means anything; fd-assay-mark-integrity adjudicates what a mark proves and lists, as its own stated failure mode, indifference to the cost of the test on the human performing it — 'cupellation destroys the sample and the warden does not care how long it took.' The tension is not resolved by this lens: it is the search area. Every place where the cost of confirming and the meaning of being confirmed are welded to each other is a site this lens investigates, because in a regime where the maker is also the assay office, ergonomics IS the integrity mechanism and there is no independence left to appeal to.
expected_isomorphisms: ratifying a pre-drafted claim versus originating one from nothing ↔ touchstone streak test versus cupellation — cheap surface test and definitive destructive test, and `success` drafted 0/5 is the only field that requires the destructive one

one confirm session on unc-rancher ↔ one sampled portion certifying a batch — the same single episode is being generalized on two axes at once (what it cost, and what it proves), and each parent sees only one failure

misattribution surviving review while invention does not ↔ a genuine mark transposed onto the wrong body — correctly-formed evidence attached to the wrong scope, and the reason it survives is that checking scope is priced as origination while assent is free

the logged AUTARCH_CARD_OVERRIDE escape hatch ↔ the assay toll that creates an evasion economy — the cheapest route is the one taken, so the toll actually paid, not the toll described, is what the estate's marks will mean

end-of-session fatigue and rubber-stamping ↔ the absence of any defacement punch — exhaustion produces not forgery but the cheapest legal mark, and `declined` costs a reason string while `provisional` cannot distinguish refused from not-yet-reached

per-unit cost extrapolated to 82 projects ↔ fineness as one millesimal number over an alloy — strength.score summarises six slots whose dearest constituent is missing everywhere, and ruling 11 ranks on it

pilot subject representativeness (unc-rancher is funded, its card is sales copy) ↔ the weight threshold that triggers compulsory assay — the pilot measures the one object whose maker independently wants to pay

a format finding, which this goal explicitly hopes for ↔ the standard in force at the moment of marking — no card carries a date letter, so a changed standard prices an unbudgeted re-ratification against marks nobody can enumerate
the funding page's stranger with money ↔ the downstream buyer who relies on a mark without re-testing — the only genuinely separate party in the chain, relying on a mark the maker also struck
focus: The weld between what a confirmation costs mk in minutes and what the resulting mark entitles a non-re-testing reader to believe — where cheap ratification and hollow certification turn out to be one defect seen from two sides.
persona: Apply the perspective of an assay warden who must personally pay for every test they order. Maker, office and warden are one person here, so no independence secures the mark — only the price paid. Such a reviewer asks two questions at once and refuses to take either alone: what did this confirmation cost, and what does the resulting mark now entitle a stranger who will never re-test to believe?
decision_lens: Report a finding ONLY if it requires BOTH parents. Pure minute-cost, fatigue or pilot-generalization is fd-hci-ratification-cost's; pure certification semantics is fd-assay-mark-integrity's. Every finding carries an intersection_justification naming what each parent supplies and why either alone lands wrong. P0: the cost structure makes a hollow mark the cheapest legal outcome. P1: the price paid or the property certified becomes unrecoverable later. P2: the coupling is unstated but benign.
review_areas: Report only what needs both lenses. For every finding name the cost fact and the certification fact, and state what each parent alone would have wrongly concluded.
Price per field, not per card: ratifying a drafted claim is a touchstone streak, originating `success` from nothing is cupellation. Name which fields a confirm session can only ever surface-test.
Misattribution: a wrongly-scoped but truly-cited `success` was available in 4 of 5 repos. Ask whether verifying a citation's scope is priced as assent or as authoring, and who pays it.
The toll and the reroute: the override costs one logged sentence, the proper path costs a session. Ask which price governs the other 81 repos, and which one unc-rancher actually measures.
unc-rancher is funded, so its card is sales copy — the one object whose maker wants to pay. Say what its minutes certify about a repo where the maker gains nothing from the mark.
There is no defacement punch. Ask what a card that fails confirmation is stamped as, whether `provisional` separates refused from not-yet-reached, and what fatigue's cheapest legal exit is.
`strength.score` is one number over a six-field alloy whose dearest constituent is absent everywhere. Ask what ruling 11 ranks when the missing field is the one nobody can afford.
No card records which standard it was confirmed against, and this goal hopes for a format finding. Price the re-ratification of already-struck marks and name who can enumerate them.

severity_examples.scenario: The cheapest legal path to exit 0 is thin assent plus a `declined` on whatever is expensive, so the estate's first real mark certifies chiefly that mk spent an evening — while the plan gate, ruling 11's ranker and the funding page each read it as a certified why. The cost structure has selected the hollow mark, and nothing downstream can tell it from a dear one.
severity_examples.condition: If no field is priced separately in the confirm procedure and no step requires mk to originate anything the drafter could not, so assent and assay cost the same.

severity_examples.scenario: unc-rancher's measured minutes are recorded as 'the confirm-step cost' backing ruling 12's 82 repetitions, while the property that mark certifies — funded, sales-copy-backed, 4 of 6 fields draftable — holds in none of the other 81. One episode is generalized on both the cost axis and the certification axis at once, and neither generalization is written down as an assumption anyone could later falsify.
severity_examples.condition: If the DONE WHEN clause records minutes without also recording which fields were ratified versus originated, and what the resulting mark asserts that a thinner repo's mark could not.

severity_examples.scenario: A `success` field cites real in-repo text at the wrong scope; mk ratifies it because reading a citation is seconds and re-scoping it is authoring work; the card exits confirmed. A genuine mark is struck on the wrong body, R1 and R2 both pass, and the measurement already warned this is the failure that survives review.
severity_examples.condition: If the confirm procedure does not price scope-verification separately from assent, or if no step obliges mk to open the cited file before confirming.

severity_examples.scenario: The goal produces the format finding it hopes for, and every card already confirmed is now marked against a superseded standard with no date letter to identify it — the re-ratification cost is unbudgeted, and the pilot measured a first confirmation, not a re-confirmation, so the estate has no number for it.
severity_examples.condition: If a card records no format version or confirmation date beside `confirmed_by` before pkg/tui reads the format.

severity_examples.scenario: Override use is logged with a reason, which makes the evasion economy observable, but the goal never commits to reading that log as cost evidence alongside the confirm minutes — so the one honest measurement of what the toll is actually worth to mk goes uncollected.
severity_examples.condition: If override reasons accumulate but are never compared against confirm-session cost when ruling 12 is revisited.

success_hints: Every finding states its intersection_justification: what fd-hci-ratification-cost supplies, what fd-assay-mark-integrity supplies, and why either alone reaches the wrong claim.
Price a claim before making it: name the operation (ratify or originate), whose minutes it spends, and what property the resulting mark asserts to a reader who will not re-test.
Where a cheap path and an expensive path both produce exit 0, name the cheap one as the one that will be taken, then say what it certifies.
Anchor to the specific field, exit code, ruling number or DONE WHEN clause where cost and certification are welded — never a general observation about ceremony.
Do not resolve the tension. If a fix would buy integrity with minutes or minutes with integrity, say so and price both sides rather than picking one.
anti_overlap: Pure confirm-minute cost, fatigue or pilot-generalization claims belong to fd-hci-ratification-cost. Raise one only where the cost fact changes what the mark certifies.
Pure certification semantics — hollow declines, sampling rules, transposition — belong to fd-assay-mark-integrity. Raise one only where a price or incentive explains why the flaw survives.
fd-datamodel-format-durability owns schema, parse and versioning bugs; fd-timberframe-load-path owns assembly order and irreversibility. Cite either as mechanism, never as the finding.
fd-archival-backlog-appraisal owns 82-project coverage and backlog; fd-infoarch-ceremony-risk owns whether cards are worth doing at all. Do not re-argue the premise on those grounds.
task_context: Review docs/proposals/2026-08-13-goal-card-loop-phase2.md before any of it runs: the why-card format, the drafter procedure, the 5-repo measurement (`success` drafted 0/5; misattribution, not invention, named as the danger), the brainstorm's 13 rulings, and the proposal to confirm one card then build the phase-2 TUI. The tension you investigate and must NOT resolve: hallmarking presumes an independent office whose warden is indifferent to what the test cost; here maker, office and warden are all mk, so the price mk chooses to pay IS the integrity mechanism. Find where that weld sits — which field, which exit code, which ruling, which DONE WHEN clause. Material: the proposal, the brainstorm, card-check.py and guard-plan-needs-card.sh under dotfiles/common/. The three depends_on docs (product-card-format.md, card-drafter.md, the measurement) are NOT in the local tree — work from the proposal's own summaries and say where that limits a claim.
